title: "ONCE YOU DIE, IT’S TOO LATE: WHY YOU MUST ACCEPT JESUS CHRIST NOW!"
paragraphs: "ONCE YOU DIE, IT’S TOO LATE: WHY YOU MUST ACCEPT JESUS CHRIST NOW!"

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, is it really necessary to accept Jesus Christ now? Can't people wait until later in life? What if they believe in God but never fully commit?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people think they have time to decide, but the Bible warns that death comes unexpectedly—and after death, judgment is FINAL!

📖 Hebrews 9:27 (KJV)
"And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:"

🚨 THE TRUTH: ONCE YOU DIE, THERE IS NO SECOND CHANCE!
✔ What happens after death, according to the Bible?
✔ What is the "Book of Life," and why does it determine your eternal destiny?
✔ How can you make sure your name is written in it—before it’s too late?
🔥 LET’S BREAK THIS DOWN WITH SCRIPTURE AND TRUTH!

THE CORE TRUTH REVEALED – WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?
📖 Hebrews 9:27 (KJV)
"And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:"

🚨 THE TRUTH: EVERYONE WILL DIE, AND THEN THEY WILL FACE GOD!
✔ Death is not the end—it is the beginning of eternity.
✔ There is no reincarnation, second chance, or “waiting period” after death.
✔ Every person will stand before God, and their eternal fate will be sealed!

📖 Romans 10:9 (KJV)
"That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved."
🔥 ONLY THOSE WHO ACCEPT JESUS CHRIST WILL BE SAVED FROM ETERNAL JUDGMENT!
💡 QUESTION: Are you truly saved, or are you just hoping for mercy after death?

DEEPER BREAKDOWN – EXPOSING THE LIES & REVEALING GOD’S TRUTH!
🚨 SATAN’S TOP DECEPTIONS ABOUT DEATH & SALVATION:

❌ LIE #1: “I can accept Jesus later in life—there’s still time.”
✔ BIBLICAL TRUTH:
📖 Proverbs 27:1 (KJV) – "Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth."
💡 Lesson: Many people die unexpectedly. Waiting is a deadly risk!

❌ LIE #2: “As long as I’m a good person, I will go to heaven.”
✔ BIBLICAL TRUTH:
📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 (KJV) – "For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast."
💡 Lesson: Good works cannot save you—only faith in Jesus Christ can!

❌ LIE #3: “A loving God won’t send people to hell.”
✔ BIBLICAL TRUTH:
📖 Revelation 20:15 (KJV) – "And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire."
💡 Lesson: Hell is real, and God’s judgment is final! He offers salvation, but rejecting Christ leads to eternal separation from Him.
🔥 DO NOT BE DECEIVED—SATAN WANTS PEOPLE TO DELAY SALVATION UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE!

FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU CHOOSE GOD’S TRUTH OR REMAIN IN DECEPTION?
💭 THE MOMENT OF DECISION IS HERE!

📖 Revelation 3:5 (KJV)
"He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels."

🚨 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔ Accept Jesus Christ now and secure your eternity in heaven.
❌ Ignore God’s warnings and risk eternal separation from Him.
🔥 YOUR ETERNAL DESTINY DEPENDS ON THIS DECISION!
💡 QUESTION: Are you truly saved, or are you just assuming you are?

📖 John 3:36 (KJV)
"He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him."
🚀 DO NOT WAIT! MAKE YOUR DECISION TODAY!

"Heavenly Father, I come before You, knowing that I am a sinner in need of salvation. I believe that Jesus Christ died for my sins and rose again. I repent of my sins, and I accept Jesus Christ as my Lord and Savior. Write my name in the Book of Life, and fill me with Your Holy Spirit. Help me to live for You and stand firm in my faith. I surrender my life completely to You. In Jesus' mighty name, AMEN!"
